tools.name: search_octothinks_presets
tools.description: Search the finished Octo Thinks decision-preset catalogue in one supported language. Use the returned slug with get_octothinks_preset for the full reviewed logic and localized content.

tools.name: get_octothinks_preset
tools.description: Get one finished Octo Thinks preset in a supported language. Returns localized copy, reviewed options and weighted criteria, unscored future-role ideas when available, the published product matrix when applicable, comparison FAQs, related guides, and a safe website handoff URL.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_octothinks_preset" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
